arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    p.ProductName, 
    c.CategoryName, 
    p.UnitsInStock, 
    p.ReorderLevel, 
    p.UnitsOnOrder, 
    p.UnitPrice,
    (p.UnitsInStock - p.ReorderLevel) AS Urgency
FROM Products p
JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID
WHERE p.UnitsInStock <= p.ReorderLevel 
  AND p.Discontinued = 0
ORDER BY Urgency ASC;

SELECT 
    p.ProductName,
    s.CompanyName AS Supplier,
    p.UnitPrice,
    p.UnitsInStock,
    p.ReorderLevel,
    p.UnitsOnOrder,
    CASE 
        WHEN ((p.ReorderLevel * 2) - p.UnitsInStock - p.UnitsOnOrder) < 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE ((p.ReorderLevel * 2) - p.UnitsInStock - p.UnitsOnOrder) 
    END AS RecommendedQuantity,
    CASE 
        WHEN ((p.ReorderLevel * 2) - p.UnitsInStock - p.UnitsOnOrder) < 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE ((p.ReorderLevel * 2) - p.UnitsInStock - p.UnitsOnOrder) * p.UnitPrice 
    END AS EstimatedCost
FROM Products p
JOIN Suppliers s ON p.SupplierID = s.SupplierID
WHERE p.UnitsInStock <= p.ReorderLevel 
  AND p.Discontinued = 0;
